pending: Remote baseline compilation remains active at packaging. Exact baseline/candidate binary inputs and verified build proof hashes will be frozen separately before execution.

schedule.randomization: Fixed permutation of the original 24 balanced rounds; no performance-driven choices.

analysis.rule: PASS requires all 62 endpoints CLEAR: point and interval upper bound strictly below 10%, without an unresolved attribution issue. Supported regression requires point and lower bound above 10% plus retained repeatability/control review. All other cases INCONCLUSIVE; equality remains unresolved.
analysis.review: Investigate observed source increases above 5%, report controls/order/round/tail contributors. No automatic 5% control precision gate, control subtraction, exclusions or repeat-until-pass.

preparation_cooldown.placement: After all remote compilation and source/artifact preparation, before measurement.
preparation_cooldown.observations: Root orchestrates and retains host observations before and after the fixed interval.
preparation_cooldown.policy: No automatic cooldown retry and no CPU or control precision exclusion. Operational/correctness/identity failures still stop with retained evidence.

invariants: All six original fixture bytes, configurations, row oracles, repetitions and default native one-warmup behavior remain unchanged.
Earlier observations and dispositions remain intact and separate; no pooling, replacements, adaptive additions or source acceptance from the warmup diagnostic.
Runner invokes existing compiled fixtures; no production or SQL edits. Every log/config/sample/warmup/RSS record retained, with bounded owned-process supervision and stop-on-failure.
Symmetric host probes precede each complete pair outside query timers; no probe occurs between pair members.

instrumentation_hygiene.scope: Synthetic serialization-volume estimate with 1500 input hashes and representative command/path lengths; not a measured production improvement.
instrumentation_hygiene.change: Write static provenance once and compact progress during timing. Complete append-only command/observation journals and full final result remain unchanged. Before-compact and before-quantile revisions and all checks are retained.
instrumentation_hygiene.bootstrap_cleanup: Avoid unused mean computation when only pooled median/p95 are required; identical numeric results checked on synthetic draws. No speed claim.

verification.archive_roundtrip: Every file in the complete preparation directory decoded, SHA256/length checked and compared byte-for-byte to its original.
